name: com.clover.remote.client.transport.usb.pos.PosUsbRemoteProtocolService
description: Clover Connector starts this Service when a supported USB payment reader is set up, connected, or disconnected. It opens the reader connection and carries payment messages between the app and the reader.
disableEffect: The app will not be able to communicate with a Clover reader over USB, so transactions that rely on it may fail.
